brief: Investing 101 for creators — 6 boring habits that built my $500K portfolio.

slots.title: Automate Every Dollar
slots.body: Set automatic transfers to your brokerage on payday. You can't spend what you never see. Consistency beats timing.
slots.tipBody: Start with just 10% of every payment you receive.

slots.title: Buy Index Funds Only
slots.body: Stop picking individual stocks. Low-cost index funds match the market and erase emotional trading mistakes instantly.
slots.tipBody: Vanguard and Fidelity offer expense ratios under 0.05%.

slots.title: Ignore Financial Noise
slots.body: Unsubscribe from market hype channels. News cycles sell fear, not returns. Your portfolio grows in silence.
slots.tipBody: Check your investments only once per quarter.

slots.title: Build a Cash Cushion
slots.body: Creators have irregular income. Keep twelve months of expenses saved before you invest aggressively.
slots.tipBody: Park emergency cash in a high-yield savings account.

slots.title: Max Tax Advantaged Accounts
slots.body: Open a SEP-IRA or Solo 401k. Every dollar you shelter from taxes compounds faster over decades.
slots.tipBody: Contributions can reduce your taxable income significantly.

slots.title: Reinvest All Dividends
slots.body: Turn on DRIP for every holding. Those small payments snowball into massive ownership over twenty years.
slots.tipBody: Dividend reinvestment is the hidden engine of wealth.

slots.body: You don't need thousands to begin. Pick one habit and execute it this week.
